about.description: Fast Rust-based bundler for the web with a modernized webpack API 🦀
about.head: 8b100de

name: v2.3.1
body:
## What's Changed

### New Features 🎉

* feat(runtime): support incremental runtime module updates by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16326

### Performance 🚀

* perf(stats): disable cacheInfo by default by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16356
* perf(watcher): coalesce queued native watcher batches by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16344
* perf(split-chunks): keep type and layer filters on the native path by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16279
* perf(stats): cache issuer paths during stats generation by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16351

### Bug Fixes 🐞

* fix: compare named cache groups by the size they actually save by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16291
* fix: don't use the line number as the column of a JS error loc by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16324
* fix(css): skip stylesheets of entries not on the page on hot update by @CyberAP in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16215
* fix(watcher): wait for aggregateTimeout after the last change by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16304
* fix: avoid using absolute paths in sourcemap hashes by @cellison-figma in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16313
* fix(binding): preserve worker callback ownership and native module lifetime by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16318
* fix: cache rendered diagnostics across rebuilds by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16358
* fix(javascript): keep exports referenced through arguments in import().then callback by @ump45nose in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16392
* fix(css): include shared initial chunks in filename runtime by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16355
* fix(css): gate the stylesheet link runtime by chunk loading by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16340
* fix(sources): preserve missing source contents as null by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16366
* fix(lightningcss-loader): preserve parser flags during stylesheet conversion by @mattcosta7 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16378
* fix(sources): don't let a generated-only mapping shadow a mapped one at the same column by @flex-mookeun in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16363
* fix(allocative): update root macro for ctor 0.13 by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16385
* fix(hmr): validate chunk versions before installation by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16360
* fix(mf): use correct async startup handlers in rspack runtime by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16399

### Refactor 🔨

* refactor(javascript): migrate to semantic symbol links by @CPunisher in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16335
* refactor(concatenate): drop repeated lookups and dead binding fields by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16219

### Document 📖

* docs: Rspack 2.3 release blog by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16179
* docs: refine Rspack 2.3 announcement wording by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16337
* docs: improve Rspack 2.3 announcement readability by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16339
* docs: document cache statistics in Stats JSON by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16353
* docs: simplify split chunks option headings and examples by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16364
* docs: explain split chunks concepts and cache groups by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16365
* docs: explain base URI in the asset base path guide by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16367
* docs: correct split chunks option behavior and defaults by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16375
* docs: add split chunks option examples by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16388

### Other Changes

* test(cli): remove redundant config extends compatibility test by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16334
* test: migrate remaining CommonJS configs to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16342
* test(cli): migrate functional configs to ESM TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16343
* test: migrate remaining mjs configs to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16354
* chore(deps): replace direct acorn dependency with swc-next parser by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16352
* test(e2e): migrate configs to ESM TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16357
* chore(deps): update dependency ubuntu to v26 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16381
* chore(deps): update patch npm dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16370
* chore(deps): update github-actions by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16380
* chore(deps): update dependency @microsoft/api-extractor to ^7.60.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16372
* chore(deps): update dependency less-loader to ^13.1.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16373
* chore(deps): update dependency glob to v14 [security] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16384
* test: move cache related tests to newCacheCases by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16336
* chore(deps): upgrade Rstack CLI to v0.9.0 by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16396

## New Contributors
* @ump45nose made their first contribution in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16392

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1
